notes.title: The Lion's Song Patch 4.2.2 + a Preview of Our Next Game!
notes.content:
Dear players, friends and fans,

It’s been a while since you last heard from us. We have been busy!
First off, we are releasing a patch for The Lion’s Song that fixes an issue with unlocking achievements. 

UPDATED 2020-01-30:
-------------------------------------------------------------
General ([i]Windows & Linux[/i]):
-	Fixed an issue that prevented players from getting an achievement when using the re-decide feature. All achievements can now be unlocked.


[h3]A Preview of Our Next Game[/h3]
Behind the scenes we have been working on something new & unannounced. Please keep a close eye on our channels – more coming soon. 
Although we can’t wait to tell you about it, we’d like to leave you with this small preview for now:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25504666/620cca487a9b877f473165339113026e2b6e6918.gif[/img]
[i]Democracy was never meant to last.[/i]


Subscribe to our newsletter at [url=http://www.flowercollectors.com]flowercollectors.com[/url] or follow us on Twitter [url=https://www.twitter.com/mipumi]@Mipumi[/url] for more updates about our next game. 

From Vienna with Love,

The Mi’pu’mi Team

notes.title: Patch 4.2 released!
notes.content:
Dear players, friends and fans,

[img]http://cloud-3.steamusercontent.com/ugc/903400877920801031/2CB5CC7A8CEDE9738997CA1A6D0C36D0EFB52125/[/img]

In time for [b]Christmas[/b], we are releasing another patch for [b]The Lion’s Song[/b] to allow you the best gaming experience during Holiday Season. We listened to your ongoing feedback and remarks to make sure we provide a stable and immersive experience in the “Wiener Moderne” at the beginning of the 20th century. 

Besides improvements in overall stability, this latest patch fixed a few minor issues in the Connection gallery, that should everyone help to collect their missing achievements.

UPDATED 2017-12-21:
===================

General:
- Minor improvements
- Fixed minor issues and bugs
- Improved overall stability

Have fun with the latest version of "The Lion's Song"!

Season Greetings and a Happy New Year!

From Vienna with Love.

Yours,
Mi'pu'mi Team

notes.title: Patch 4.1 released!
notes.content:
Dear players, friends and fans,

Thanks for all your positive and very warm feedback we received since release of Episode 4 and the Full Season package.

We carefully listened to your feedback and just released a patch with one major and some minor fixes.

UPDATED 2017-08-03:
===================

Major:
- Fixed crash in episode 4
- Improved various scenes for decide again feature

General:
- Minor bugfixes
- Improved overall loading times
- Improved overall stability

Translations:
- Minor translation bugfixes across all languages
- Minor improvements for German, Russian and English

Have fun with the latest version of "The Lion's Song"!

notes.title: Episode 1 & 2 Update
notes.content:
Dear players, friends and fans!

With the release of “Episode 3 – Derivation”, we also updated “Episode 1 – Silence” & "Episode 2 - Anthology". As you already might know, the way you play Episode 3 affects scenes in Episode 1 and Episode 2 - and vice versa.

One more reason to return to Wilma’s cabin and Franz' studio after finishing “Episode 3 – Derivation” to find out what consequences your decisions have on the previously played story.

GENERAL UPDATE 2017-03-16: 
==========================
- Improved overall loading times
- Improved overall stability
- Added closed captions in all languages for episode 1 and 2
- Added Russian language for episode 1 and 2
========================== 

Localization 2017-03-16: 
==========================
- Changed some phrases in EFIGS
- Fixed some minor typos in all languages
========================== 

Have fun with the latest version of "The Lion's Song"!

tags.feature: - Added closed captions in all languages for episode 1 and 2
- Added Russian language for episode 1 and 2

tags.bug: - Fixed some minor typos in all languages
